text: 中办、国办：推动集成电路、工业母机、高端仪器、先进材料、生物制造等重点领域关键核心技术攻关取得决定性突破
text_en: General Offices of the CPC Central Committee and the State Council: Push for decisive breakthroughs in core technology research in key fields such as integrated circuits, industrial mother machines, high-end instruments, advanced materials and biomanufacturing
